title: ResourceManifest
description: The intrinsic layer/extends_manifest_id pairing is enforced by this schema: generic requires null and local requires an Identifier. Relationally invalid candidate manifests remain representable: ResourceManifestValidator owns duplicate resource IDs/paths, self-edges, missing/cyclic or generic-to-local dependencies, compatibility, manifest mismatch, and forbidden local replacement. Schema conformance alone does not authorize or accept a manifest.

resources.description: Nonempty and canonically ordered by the complete represented resource key while preserving duplicate IDs, duplicate paths, and exact duplicate entries for deterministic relational validation.
